=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:14341-14377 (handle_comprehensive_release_callback_if_needed; also 14461-14467 per openai_gpt-6-luna) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A pinned proving run can merge while its verifying run is terminally not dispatched (no_docs, all_docs_processed, dispatcher_missing, retries_exhausted, the `*)` arm), or the proving project can fail (luna); either way the callback is marked handled without calling `comprehensive_release_cycle_freeze`, so the `promote-cycle-frozen` tag is never deleted.
  WHY: `comprehensive_release_cycle_freeze` is wired only into `comprehensive_promotion_gate_before_final_merge` (role verifying), and the next cycle exits at guard 6 (`insufficient_docs`) or guards 3/4 (`no_code_changes`) before stale-tag cleanup in `pin_freeze` runs, so `promote-candidate` stays frozen and `@promote-candidate` wrappers run stale code for up to `PROMOTE_CYCLE_FREEZE_MAX_SECS` (172800 s, 48 h).
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:839-859 (with pin_freeze candidate_advanced ~600-615, 764-767) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: In the pinned candidate_advanced path, `pin_candidate_sha`/`smoke_sha` is the advanced branch tip, but `if [ "${pin_mode}" != "true" ] && [ "${smoke_sha}" != "${main_tip}" ]` skips the checkout, so the working tree stays at `main_tip`.
  WHY: The dispatcher enumerates docs from the working tree (`unprocessed_docs`, scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh:338) while `GITHUB_SHA` names the candidate. Docs that exist at one commit but not the other are miscounted, and a proving run can be skipped (no_docs) even though the candidate has eligible docs.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:14367 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The DISPATCHED-arm comment "promotes `${DEFAULT_BRANCH_TRACKING:-main}` as of this merge to `stable`" is posted unchanged for pinned cycles, which actually promote the marker's smoke_sha (the frozen candidate).
  WHY: Every pinned cycle tells operators the wrong promotion commit. Severity disagreement: minimax rated MAJOR, sonnet/luna/qwen rated NIT, gemini gave no rating; the highest is used.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:573-583 (also 768-772; pin_freeze tag-ref POST) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `PIN_TAG_CREATED=true` and the `pin_release_freeze` EXIT trap are set only after the tag-ref POST succeeds. A non-"already exists" failure (5xx, or a lost response after GitHub created the ref) returns `tag_ref_create` with nothing cleaned up, and the tag object is orphaned.
  WHY: The cycle runs unpinned while the follower treats the leftover tag as an active freeze until the next cycle's stale-tag check or the 48 h age limit. Severity disagreement: minimax/luna/qwen rated MAJOR, sonnet rated NIT, gemini gave no rating; the highest is used.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:572-608 (pin_freeze initial branch PATCH and candidate-advanced tag-ref PATCH) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Both PATCH calls use bare `gh api` instead of `gh_retry gh api`.
  WHY: A transient 5xx fails the freeze at once (`branch_patch`/`candidate_tag_ref`) and forces an unpinned cycle with no retry, and a failed re-point orphans the tag object.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:~600 (pin_freeze compare_status fallback) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A failed compare read (empty status) or an unexpected status is reported as `PIN_FREEZE_DETAIL=branch_not_fast_forward`, the same as a real divergence.
  WHY: The log `freeze_failed detail=branch_not_fast_forward` blames a transient API failure on branch divergence and points the operator the wrong way. Only diagnostics are affected; the unpinned fallback is still safe.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:pin_freeze candidate-advanced failure paths (`candidate_tag_object` / `_candidate_tag_ref` arms) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `pin_release_freeze` deletes only the re-pointed tag ref, so if the second `pin_create_tag_object` succeeds and the tag-ref PATCH then fails, the second tag object is orphaned.
  WHY: Repeated divergent-branch cycles pile up orphan tag objects that are left for GitHub GC to clean up.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:comprehensive_release_cycle_freeze stderr grep `grep -qiE '404|422|not found|does not exist'` | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A 5xx body that contains the substring `404` would be classified as `absent` instead of `delete_failed`.
  WHY: A real delete failure would be reported to operators as `tag=absent`, a clean release.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~13715, ~13728, ~14091 (comprehensive_promotion_gate_before_final_merge pinned branch) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The pinned gate makes 3 API calls (tag ref, tag object, branch ref) to read the tag and the branch.
  WHY: This is not a correctness problem, but it adds a call on the hot path of every pinned cycle. A batched GraphQL read could meet the spec's 2-call budget.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:comprehensive_stable_tag_commit header comment | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The helper now takes an optional `$1` (default `stable`), but the header still names only `stable` and does not document the parameter.
  WHY: A future caller may assume the helper is stable-only and write a duplicate helper.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: P3.6: "release the freeze (delete the tag) on every terminal promotion state" of a pinned cycle, including the case where a pinned proving run completes but its verifying run is terminally not dispatched
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh handle_comprehensive_release_callback_if_needed, terminal `*)` arm (lines 14370-14376) and the SKIPPED/retries_exhausted exits
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The diff adds `comprehensive_release_cycle_freeze` only inside comprehensive_promotion_gate_before_final_merge (role verifying, eight terminal branches); handle_comprehensive_release_callback_if_needed has no added call in its SKIPPED / `*)` arms, so the tag is never released on that path.
- requirement: P3.6 poller: "skip `comprehensive_untested_commits_json` and read the tag and the branch instead (2 calls)."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh comprehensive_promotion_gate_before_final_merge pinned branch and comprehensive_stable_tag_commit
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: `comprehensive_stable_tag_commit promote-cycle-frozen` reads the tag ref (line 13715) and the tag object (line 13728), then the branch is read separately (line 14091): 3 calls, not 2. Minimax notes 2 calls cannot be reached over REST for annotated tags, and qwen notes the spec may have counted the tag as one logical read.
- requirement: P3.8 tests for the pinned-mode scenarios in tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py, tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py, tests/test_orchestrate_poll_promote_cycle.py
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_promote_cycle.py test_pinned_cycle_reconciles_an_advanced_branch
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: test_pinned_cycle_reconciles_an_advanced_branch does not check that doc enumeration is correct when the branch advances.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:handle_comprehensive_release_callback_if_needed, lines 14341-14376 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `*)` arm (COMPREHENSIVE_VERIFICATION_NOT_DISPATCHED) and the SKIPPED retries_exhausted fallthrough never call `comprehensive_release_cycle_freeze`, so the `promote-cycle-frozen` tag stays when the verifying run is not dispatched.
  WHY: The next cycle exits at guard 6 (`skip_cycle insufficient_docs`, line 727) before `pin_freeze`, so `promote-candidate` stays frozen up to 172800 s (`promote_candidate_follow.sh:213-222`). Fix: read `.pinned` from `cycle_metadata_json` and call `comprehensive_release_cycle_freeze "${pinned}"`.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:`if [ "${pin_mode}" != "true" ] && [ "${smoke_sha}" != "${main_tip}" ]; then` + pin_freeze candidate_advanced `pin_candidate_sha="${branch_tip}"` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Pinned candidate_advanced skips the checkout, so the dispatcher gets GITHUB_SHA=smoke_sha but enumerates docs from a tree still at main_tip (scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh:338).
  WHY: This breaks the invariant that the working tree and GITHUB_SHA are the same commit. Fix: drop the `pin_mode != true` condition.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:line 14367 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The DISPATCHED-arm comment still says the main tip as of this merge is promoted, but pinned cycles promote the marker's smoke_sha.
  WHY: Every pinned cycle's comment names the wrong promotion target.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:pin_freeze tag-ref POST → `PIN_FREEZE_DETAIL=tag_ref_create; return 1` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A non-"already exists" failure leaves PIN_TAG_CREATED false, so the caller's cleanup does nothing.
  WHY: A ref that GitHub created anyway holds `promote-candidate` frozen until the next stale-tag check or the 48 h limit. Fix: call `pin_delete_tag` before returning.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:pin_freeze compare_status / `branch_not_fast_forward` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed compare read is reported as `branch_not_fast_forward`.
  WHY: The log blames a transient API failure on divergence. Only diagnostics are affected.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: P3.6: "release the freeze (delete the tag) on every terminal promotion state" of a pinned cycle.
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, handle_comprehensive_release_callback_if_needed, not-dispatched arm (lines 14370-14376).
  Evidence of absence: The release calls are only inside comprehensive_promotion_gate_before_final_merge (role verifying); the proving-callback terminal path has none.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: P3.6: "skip comprehensive_untested_commits_json and read the tag and the branch instead (2 calls)."
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh pinned block of comprehensive_promotion_gate_before_final_merge, comprehensive_stable_tag_commit.
  Evidence of absence: Annotated tag = git/ref/tags + git/tags/<object>, plus git/ref/heads/promote-candidate = 3 calls. Budget overrun only.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:around line 14356 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A pinned proving run whose verifying run is terminally not dispatched never calls comprehensive_release_cycle_freeze, so the tag lingers.
  WHY: Stale-tag cleanup only runs in pin_freeze, which is never reached here, so the system can stay stalled or inconsistent for up to PROMOTE_CYCLE_FREEZE_MAX_SECS (48 h).
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:lines 764-76
